name: Marsh
description: Dack's friend and fellow adept young mage, killed in a fight with brutes.

timeline.summary: Dack and Marsh, adept young mages lacking judgment, pick a fight with brutes one night and Marsh is killed.
timeline.quote: One night, their genius got the best of them and they picked a fight with brutes, resulting in the death of Marsh.

relations.note: Friends and fellow mages in their youth.
relations.quote: As a youth, Dack and his friend Marsh were adept mages
